question.wording: Did the taxpayer receive ALL the interest on this Form 1099-INT as a nominee — it actually belongs to someone else?

options.label: Yes — all of it belongs to another person
No — some or all of it is the taxpayer's

default.because: Interest on the recipient's own form is theirs unless a preparer says they received it as a nominee

citation.wording: If you receive a Form 1099-INT and interest as a nominee for another person, see the discussion on Nominee distributions, later.
